newsitem.title: USA: First USA Paymentech buys portfolio.
newsitem.headline: First USA Paymentech buys portfolio.

text.p: First USA Paymentech Inc said Monday it acquired the merchant processing portfolio of TransGlobal Systems Inc for an undisclosed sum.
The portfolio includes approximately 2,300 merchants in the hospitality and travel industries and more than $1.6 billion in annual credit card sales volume.

Paymentech is the third largest processor of bankcard transactions in the United States, with approximately $36.5 billion in bankcard sales volume during the last four quarters. The company also issues commercial card products and provides commercial card payment and processing.
